main_body: A drum on a wooden frame. The skin top is a tan ellipse (rows ~3-11). The orange-red cylindrical shell is below (rows ~11-22), with a yellow stud trim, between two wooden posts and a crossbar.
top_band: tan/cream drumskin ellipse, rows ~3-11 at the centre column, lightest at upper left, with a darker tan lower edge and a yellow-studded rim
evidence: In the central column a tan elliptical skin runs from about row 3 to row 11. A yellow stud and rim line marks the front edge at about rows 11-12. Below it is a dark orange shell with shading, rows 12-22, ending in a dark red base with a gold trim line. The top reads as a real ellipse surface, as in the guide's green barrel and column. The shell is rounded and shaded left to right.

style.evidence: The drum has about 5 orange steps on the shell plus 3-4 tan steps on the skin. Outlines are dark red-brown and brown, tinted to the material, with no black sticker line. The yellow studs add detail. The skin and shell have some shading variation but little grain texture. The wooden frame is mostly flat brown with a light edge. Overall it is close to the references but a little lighter in texture.
